<!-- pr-reviewer: 0207a55d13799afc4fb154445376a002614c1269 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

What looks good
- Test-only: the diff is six `.nc` goldens under `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/tormach/`; no source, build.rs, scripts, `.github` or dependency changes.
- Every golden diff is exactly #570's safe-plane descent: the old `G0 ... Z<probe depth>` becomes `G0 ... Z<safe plane>` (Z1.9685 / Z50), then `G38.3` down to the old depth with the `PROBE HIT ON POSITIONING` guard. The metric bore keeps its rapid at Z50 and `G38.3` to Z25 and Z15. No other line changes except the `o500N` renumbering from the one added guard (checked in probe_face, probe_boss_centre, probe_bore_centre_mm).
- No rapid below the safe plane in the changed files.
- Body has `Changelog: none` and `Fixes #695`; the commit subject is conventional.

Local results (trial merge with upstream/main was already up to date, no conflicts)
| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| probe_tormach | 7/7 pass |
| probe_guard | 5/5 pass |
| probe_op | 12/12 pass |
| clippy | not run: no code changed |

The full app test build on main currently fails in `lathe_thread_travel.rs` (#686), unrelated to this PR, so suites were built and run individually.

Requested before merge
- None.

Questions / notes (not blocking)
- Opened as non-draft; fine since the gate was green.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
